project:
Merge 3 or more of the same number tiles that are adjacent to each other horizontally and/or vertically. You'll start with 5 tiles that will be added or subtracted (depending on its sign) to tiles on the board. You can only play the rightmost tile. Drag and drop that tile on the board to try and line up 3 or more numbers. Once you make a match, the tiles will merge into one tile with a number one larger than the tiles matched. You will also get another tile added to your play list.

If you have earned enough coins you can drop a bomb on a tile to remove it or drop the wand on a tile to remove all like numbered tiles on the board. Dropping a "-1" tile on a "1" tile will cause that tile to be deleted.
